Preparing Japanese and Indian teams to work together

Capable teams still need to understand each other’s expectations.

The situation

A Japanese company is about to start working with a new engineering team in India. Its Japanese managers have not specified or reviewed work from overseas before, and the Indian engineers are unfamiliar with Japanese documentation and review practices.

How SetuHashi could help

Prepare the Japanese team to specify, review and govern the work, design professional and language preparation for both teams with appropriate training partners, and review what could help people stay.

What the assignment could produce

A readiness plan and supporting practices, a team-readiness programme and a retention plan, according to the agreed scope.

The intended value

Teams that understand their responsibilities and each other’s working expectations from the start.
